Black & White series · LTR

Legendary Treasures

Released November 6, 2013 · 140 cards

Expanded

Legendary Treasures is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Black & White series, released in English on November 6, 2013. Its main set has 113 cards, plus 27 secret rares numbered beyond the set (140 in total). It includes 134 Pokémon, 5 Trainer and 1 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

46 illustrators worked on Legendary Treasures. Most cards: Atsuko Nishida (7), Eske Yoshinob (6), Kagemaru Himeno (6), Mizue (6), Akira Komayama (5), Kanako Eo (5), kawayoo (5), kirisAki (5).
